prompt: 创建一个建在寒冷山谷中的废弃科幻研究前哨站。

objects.name: Cold valley terrain
objects.description: Rugged snow-dusted valley floor with raised rocky shoulders and a clear approach corridor.

objects.name: West low concrete research building
objects.description: Low rectangular reinforced-concrete laboratory mass with a service door and slit windows.

objects.name: East low concrete research building
objects.description: Matching low concrete annex with a practical entry and service equipment bay.

objects.name: Enclosed metal connector corridor
objects.description: A covered metal-and-frosted-glass corridor physically joining the two buildings.

objects.name: Main entry steps
objects.description: Short repeated stair flights aligned to the approach path.

objects.name: Small communications platform
objects.description: Raised steel platform beside the west entry with guard rails and service clearance.

objects.name: Weathered retro-futurist communications terminal
objects.description: Large thick steel terminal with antenna mast, dish, tactile control panel, cyan status screen, and exposure wear.

objects.name: Reusable industrial storage crates
objects.description: A small repeated cluster of battered storage and equipment boxes.

objects.name: Sparse cold-weather pine group
objects.description: A few low-poly wind-bent pines on the valley shoulders.

objects.name: Rugged rock fields
objects.description: Grouped angular rocks that frame the valley without cluttering the base entrance.

objects.name: Sparse industrial scrap
objects.description: A few deliberately placed beams, drums, and panels showing long abandonment.
